description: This is a test class for the EmployeeService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the EmployeeService class, including getting associated services, checking supervisor status, deleting employees, and verifying email uniqueness.

classes.name: EmployeeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeService methods in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new EmployeeService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEmployeeDao() returns an instance of EmployeeDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Verifies that getEmployeeEventService() returns an instance of EmployeeEventService.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Verifies that getEmployeeTerminationService() returns an instance of EmployeeTerminationService.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieving subordinate IDs by supervisor ID with different configurations, including chain support.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Checks whether the isSupervisor() method correctly identifies a supervisor.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Tests deleting a list of employees and verifies the number of deletions returned.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Tests retrieving supervisor IDs for a subordinate, including chain support scenarios.

methods.name: testIsUniqueEmail
methods.description: Verifies email uniqueness checks against existing records in the database.
